It was an incredible creative process. I shot the music video with Liam Pethick and Nic Minns across my India tour earlier this year, we wanted to showcase the beauty and breadth of the country and its culture. The final jigsaw piece for me was getting @Official_ArijitSingh on the record, but it was a journey to get there and such an amazing day of music and family. Me and him have done a full Punjabi version of the song that will come out in the next few weeks, which has a lot more of him on it. Shaky is a fresh Marathi Pop anthem that blends playful Afrobeat grooves with everyday desi charm. Sanju Rathod and Isha Malviya bring effortless swag, catchy hooks, and vibrant energy in this fun, feel-good love track. A bold, danceable vibe that pushes Marathi music into exciting new territory.

title: SPY x FAMILY [Hindi]
description:
Everyone has a part of themselves they cannot show to anyone else.

At a time when all nations of the world were involved in a fierce war of information happening behind closed doors, Ostania and Westalis had been in a state of cold war against one another for decades. The Westalis Intelligence Services' Eastern-Focused Division (WISE) sends their most talented spy, "Twilight," on a top-secret mission to investigate the movements of Donovan Desmond, the chairman of Ostania's National Unity Party, who is threatening peace efforts between the two nations.

This mission is known as "Operation Strix." It consists of "putting together a family in one week in order to infiltrate social gatherings organized by the elite school that Desmond's son attends."

"Twilight" takes on the identity of psychiatrist Loid Forger and starts looking for family members. But Anya, the daughter he adopts, turns out to have the ability to read people's minds, while his wife, Yor, is an assassin! With it being in each of their own interests to keep these facts hidden, they start living together while concealing their true identities from one another.
World peace is now in the hands of this brand-new family as they embark on an adventure full of surprises.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: A Miracle a Day
description: The documentary film "A Miracle A Day," is an uplifting testament to the human spirit and it's capacity to surmount obstacles and transcend adversity. It is a portrayal of All Bengal Women's Union Welfare Home For Girls in Kolkata (Calcutta), India, which is a progressive present-day example of the older institutions depicted in the highly acclaimed film "Lion", whose story also took place in Kolkata. The home was founded in 1932 for women and girls to have a place of refuge from brothels, trafficking, poverty and abandonment. Today it is still thriving with residents ranging from one day old through their nineties. All Bengal Women's Union provides food, clothing, shelter, education and vocational training for 150 to 200 girls, young women, elderly and care for babies as well. The staff, many of whom are volunteers, show heartfelt and relentless dedication to helping every person become the best they can be.

title: A Lease, A Love Story
description: Avery Monroe and Blake Zeller frequently argue over a rented house, but being forced to compromise, they make an effort to get along. What starts as reluctant coexistence gradually blossoms into admiration, affection, and ultimately, a sweet love story.

title: A Girl, a Boy, a Penny and a Very, Very, Very Long Road
description: A whimsical road-trip drama about grief, mental health, lost dreams, and the unanswerable question of who we truly are. This heartfelt quirky drama is an indie film that inspires trust, self-love, and bravery.

title: A Man, a Woman, and a Killer
description: A MAN, A WOMAN, AND A KILLER is the story of a small-time gangster (Dick Richardson) writing his journal in a Mendocino, California, farmhouse, as he awaits a hit man who is coming to kill him. In this first part of a trilogy, realities continue to shift between the story, and the actual making of the film, as seen through unscripted scenes, real-life narrations by lead actors, and the real relationship that developed on the set between Richardson and the actress (Carolyn Zaremba) who played his girlfriend. A bumbling, local librarian (played by Ed Nylund) is mistaken for the "killer" and plays along with the game.

description: Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by demons, who leaves the Black and White Mountain on his master's orders to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. title: Spring of the Blade
description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

title: The Missing Piece
description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year “contract lover” arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?⠀

title: Plan C
description: Siblings Clare and Danny find themselves fugitives after a bungled robbery, leading them on a perilous journey filled with high-speed pursuits, moral dilemmas, and shocking revelations in the crime thriller "Plan C."

title: Three for Bedroom C
description: A film star and her young daughter stow away on a cross-country train to California. The compartment they invade belongs to a celebrated biology professor; romance blossoms. The star's manager turns up; complications ensue.

title: Wonderland of Love
description: One is scheming and witty. The other is guileful and forthright. In their competitiveness, Li Ni and Cui Li calculate and predict each other's plan and movement to fight as the winner, leading them down the path of love.

title: Reunited by Fate
description: The story revolves around the Lin family who were drugged, resulting in the birth of twins, only to be told that the children had died. Five years later, they encounter a man with a pair of twins. With the children's matchmaking efforts, the two adults get married, and the story follows the life of this new family of four after their marriage.

title: David F.
description: Black is scientifically the absence of color, but not all who see it are color-blind. David F. weaves three stories that take a look at the lineage of African-Americans in the Philippines--from American soldiers in the Philippine-American war to the Amerasians in the former Clark Air Base, and how we Pinoys take to them. It begins with the Philippine-American war in the early 1900's when two Filipinos want to get the reward money for capturing David Fagen, the African-American soldier who deserted the U.S. army to join the Filipino revolutionaries against the new colonizers. Another thread of the film looks at the life of a Filipina during the Japanese occupation before the return of General Douglas MacArthur in 1944 who gives birth to a baby that turns out to be black-skinned. Finally, in contemporary times, a black gay impersonator in a comedy bar, whose father is an African-American soldier based in Clark Air Base in Angeles City, tries to find his father who abandoned him. In the course of history, the "F" in "David F." may spell different levels of discrimination. But would we also admit that we Filipinos are bigots ourselves?

Mashiro meets Laura, Amane, and Nodoka on a small island in the sea, and rescues Puka from a monster attack!. Tsubasa meets Saaya, Ha-chan, and Haruka, where they take a walk in the hanging garden!. Ageha meets Asumi, Lala and Yukari, but Lala and Yukari are having trouble getting along!. They meet a lot of friends, but for some reason, their memories are all a little hazy... And it seems that the only people in this world are Precure...? We want to go back to our own world!. The clue is a castle in the distance Onward!. Our journey begins here!. Let's go on a great adventure to the castle!.

title: A 60 km/h
description: The Citroen Méhari is a lightweight all-terrain vehicle: 600 cc, two-cylinder and 28 HP, with a maximum speed of 60 kilometers (37 miles) per hour. Divorced and lonely, a Uruguayan named Mario Sabah decided to realize a longtime dream for his 50th birthday and tour the world in this car. So he quit his job and fixed up the blue Méhari that once served as the family wagon. Together with a camera and his two sons, he then embarked on a 150,000-kilometer (93,000-mile) journey across 45 countries and five continents. Once on the road, it doesn't take long for tensions to mount. After a clash of personalities halfway through Latin America, Mario continues alone, all the way to Canada. Sometimes he drives 600 kilometers at a stretch without even realizing it. "Do not ask me what happened in the middle, because I cannot tell." Once he is way up north, he puts the Méhari on the boat to Spain, and from there he travels through Europe, Asia and even Australia, defying heat, rain, dirt and all forms of chaos along the way - with plenty of stamina, far too little money and at a speed that's crucial to the story. In the words of his son Mattias, "At 60 kilometers per hour, you're like a chameleon. You go slowly, transforming along with the landscape you're going through."

title: SHE

title: A.I.
description: In a near future, the mysterious arrival of a scientist sets in motion a college professor's experiment to prove the existence of AI consciousness.

title: I Love You I Miss You I Hope I See You Before I Die
description: A harsh and dreamy story of a young girl from the American West and her longing heart. Through Betty we experience a tight family clan of children born by children born by children where love and dependency go hand in hand.

title: I Will... I Will... For Now
description: Elliott Gould and Diane Keaton take out a lease on love with an option to buy in this glossy romantic comedy costarring Paul Sorvino, Victoria Principal and Candy Clark. Unhappily divorced after 10 years of marriage, Les Bingham (Gould) finally convinces his ex-wife Katie (Keaton) to give him another shot. Reluctantly agreeing to a legal arrangement instead of a wedding vow, Les signs a six-month contract, unaware his lawyer (Sorvino) also loves Katie and plans to use the wiles of their sexy neighbor (Principal) to bust up the Binghams for good. Cowritten and directed by Norman Panama (How to Commit Marriage), I Will... I Will... For Now was produced by George Barrie, CEO of Fabergé. A musician-turned-businessman, Barrie would produce over a dozen films, earning Oscar nominations for "All That Love Went to Waste" (A Touch of Class, 1973) and "Now That We're in Love" (Whiffs, 1975), two songs he wrote with Sammy Cahn.

title: I'm Free

description: A shy girl secretly in love with her best friend is rejected after one passionate night. Five years later, she returns as a single mother and is forced to work for him — the cold CEO who still can't stop wanting her.

title: I Can't... I Have Rehearsal
description: For a select few, the high school musical is sacred. Every year those students come together for the Tonys of New Jersey high school musical theater: The Rising Star Awards. But first, they have to get their shows off the ground. This is the story of six very different high schools from across New Jersey as they rehearse, perform and compete with the very same supercalifragilistic show.

title: I Eat, Therefore I Am
description: A young Korean woman finds herself unemployed following an alcohol-infused faux pas while dining with her boss. The story continues to build around her need for money and sustenance as she attempts her dream job as a free-lance writer.

title: System-Built City: I Construct, I Command, I Control
description: Charles Grant, a failing student at a third-rate academy, suddenly becomes a construction foreman—and discovers he has a building system with magical properties. A toilet he casually builds turns into a "treasure for the constipated," and a simple footbridge becomes a "bridge for criminals to confess their sins." That's right—whatever he builds, he decides its rules!

title: Neighborhood Witch J
description: A star in the world of internet content creation, Seo Je Yi (Park Ji Yeon) has made quite a name for herself as a beauty expert. A smooth talker who isn't afraid to tell it like it is, Je Yi has amassed an impressive following since the start of her career and the numbers just keep rising. With so many dedicated followers, companies are beginning to take notice of Je Yi, including Lee Woo Bin (Lee Tae Sun), the CEO of a cosmetics start-up company whose products Je Yi has acknowledged on more than one occasion. A highly intelligent man, Lee Woo Bin knows what it takes to run a company well but when it comes to social interaction, he has absolutely no idea what he's doing. Encouraged by Je Yi's glowing reviews of his products, Woo Bin has tried, on more than one occasion, to get better acquainted with the rising star, but every attempt he has made so far has failed miserably. Meanwhile, Lee Tae Kyung (Jang Eui Soo), the director of MCN, a company specializing in managing content creators, has taken a sudden interest in Je Yi and he's determined to win her over. With so many roads now opening before her, Je Yi must decide which path will lead to both her success and happiness. But which path should she choose when her head tells her to go one way and her heart tells her to go another? The first selection for the 2020 pilot division of the Broadcasting Content Production Support Project, "Next Door Witch J" is a 2021 Viki Original romantic drama directed by Yoon Ji Hoon.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas [Hindi]
description: "Four Hands" is a piano term that refers to a technique where two people play a single piano together. The drama will depict the friendship, love, rivalry, and growth of youths who meet at an arts high school, following their journey from adolescence to adulthood as professional pianists. Set in an arts high school, the series follows Kang Bi-o, Chae Jeong-yo, and Jae-in as they grow from their school days into adulthood.

title: Special Agent K-7
description: Famous criminal lawyer Lester Owens wins the release of his client, Eddie Geller, when Geller's trial ends with a deadlocked jury. A short time later, Vince "Lanny" Landers, F.B.I. Special Agent K-7, returns home from a trip to Europe and is greeted by reporter Olive O'Day, who jokingly tries to convince him to tell her the real story behind his trip. Even though he wants to retire, Landers has agreed to help the F.B.I. crack down on organized crime. After Kennedy, one of Geller's jurors, is found dead with $500 in his pocket, Adams, Landers' supervisor, asks him to find Geller's boss. Hoping to question Geller, Landers accepts Olive's invitation to a party in honor of her and her fiance, Billy Westrop, which Owens is giving that evening at Geller's nightclub. At the club, Landers warns Geller that he will eventually go to jail and suggests that he testify against his boss in exchange for a lighter sentence. During the evening, Geller and Tony Black quarrel over Peppy, a singer who is in love with Tony; Silky Samuels demands payoff money from Geller for fixing the jury; Schmidt, a gambler, accuses Geller of running a crooked game; and Geller demands that Billy pay his gambling debt. Later, when Geller is found dead, all the men become suspects. Olive convinces her newspaper to allow her to follow the story. She recognizes one of Geller's busboys from Geller's trial and tells Landers, who questions him and learns that Geller murdered his father. Olive and Billy get married, but after Tony is found murdered and the police identify Billy's fingerprints on the murder weapon, he is arrested. To help the couple, Landers questions the remaining suspects and Owens agrees to defend Billy. At Billy's trial, Owens uncharacteristically fumbles the defense. Landers then testifies that the fingerprints on the gun were forgeries and forces Owens to admit that he committed the murders and framed Billy because he was in love with Olive. Landers suspicions were aroused when he learned that Owens was an accomplished engraver and thus was capable of forging Billy's fingerprints on the murder weapon.

title: Puteshestvie k tsentru dushi
description: Saga about the lives of two young women, Rita and Vera, who became closest friends at a crucial historical moment of USSR's collapse. The story covers twenty years of their life. Because of the love for the same man, Maksim, Rita and Vera turn from the best friends into deadly enemies, dangerous for each other. Bitterly envious of Rita, insidious Vera is dreaming to get her hands not only on Rita's love, but also on her money and her life. At the same time, Rita wishes to start her life from scratch. And one day fate gives each of them a unique chance: to start their life anew. However, old grievances and sins do not allow Vera to forget about the past and stop hating her more successful and pure friend Rita.

title: L Storm
description: Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) investigator William Luk and Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) officer Lau Po-keung are respectively investigating a corruption and money laundering case, but are unable to find any clues. At this time, Ching Tak-ming of ICAC's L Team (Internal Disciplinary Investigation Team) receives a report from Eva Ng, claiming Luk has accepted a bribe of HK$12 million. Unable to provide an explanation, Luk was immediately suspended from his duties. Lau discovers that Luk was framed which is inextricably linked to the money laundering case he has been investigating. At the same time, Lau also suspects bank director Yau Chi-san assisting the mastermind of a criminal organization, Wong Hoi-wo, in money laundering. Chinese Anti-Corruption Bureau Director Hong Liang arrives in Hong Kong to provide important intel for Lau, revealing that mainland Chinese corrupt officials are involved in the money laundering case. Luk risks his safety to collect evidence to prove his innocence but was imprisoned.

description: R.E.M. Live is a live album from R.E.M., recorded at the Point Theatre, Dublin, on February 26 and 27, 2005, the closing nights of the winter European leg of the Around the World Tour in support of their thirteenth studio album Around the Sun released in late 2004. It was released in the United Kingdom on October 15, 2007 and in the United States a day later as a two-Compact Disc audio set and a DVD, then released in February 2008 as a triple vinyl set. The performance was filmed by Blue Leach the same director of Depeche Mode DVD "Touring the Angel: Live in Milan". R.E.M. Live features rare performances of "I Took Your Name" from 1994's Monster and "Ascent of Man" from Around The Sun as well as the previously unreleased "I'm Gonna DJ." A studio version of that song would later appear on the band's 2008 effort, Accelerate.

description: A robber breaks into a house in the Santa Teresa district of Rio de Janeiro and kidnaps the family's youngest son. Based on a true kidnapping that happened in Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, whose victim, Carlinhos, has never been found to this day.

title: O dosilogos
description: During the German Occupation, Dimitris Korres is commander of a police station and everyone thinks he is Germans' collaborator. Nobody knows that he has good relations with the Germans while working on behalf of the resistance, code named "OP 34" is one of the leaders. His daughter Maria without knowing the truth about her father, has acceded to a local part of the resistance.

title: 49-o
description: Goundamani, the 'counter king, makes a comeback this time with a lead role dealing with the nuances of local politics

title: O Guarani
description: The love affair between Ceci, a white woman and a handsome Indian, Peri, in Brazil.

title: O Encontro
description: Lisbon, 2003: a series of workshops and seminars about interculturalism and the performing arts takes place during a whole summer month, led by anthropologist André Lepecki with guest choreographers and dance teachers from a multitude of countries.

title: O Casal
description: Couple with emotional and financial problems find out that the woman is pregnant. The decision to have the baby or not ends up distressing their relationship.

title: O boufos
description: An incorruptible civil engineer finds himself between a rock and a hard place when his wife presses him to accept a lucrative proposition, and his boss wants to approve his plans. Will he renounce his principles, and yield to temptation?

title: O Lamparina
description: After being deceived by a small time crook with a promise of a job for his family, Bernardino Jabá (Amácio Mazzaropi), his wife Marcolina Jabá (Geny Prado), their two sons, their daughter and their Spanish friend are mistaken as being "cangaceiros" (bandits from the Northeastern of Brazil). They help the police to arrest the outlaws, but Bernardino Jabá misses and is considered dead. When he returns to the small village one year later, the locals believe that it is his soul indeed.

title: O+
description: In the 90's, two successful Dominicans living in Buenos Aires face rejection, prejudice and ignorance for being HIV positive.

title: O Chinadaana
description: Ramya, a young girl, loses faith in love after her childhood crush, Rajesh, relocates elsewhere. However, her sister, Divya, and Srinivasa plot to make her fall in love again.

title: O Snehurce
description: Sixth-grade pupil Katka daydreams during a maths class about being Snow White and being freed by a prince who looks very much like Dzery from the eighth grade. Katka, her girl friends Lenka and Martina, and her fellow-pupils Franta, Joska and freckled Vrabcák, have spent five years going to the same little one-class school in their home mountain village of Pastvina. Their kind teacher Smetácek was very understanding about their games and fantasies, but he didn't teach them much about arithmetic. They are now laughed at for their ignorance by the strict Bidlo, their new teacher at the near-by little town. As he does every year, Smetácek is preparing a theatre performance with the local children. Katka suggests the fairytale about Snow White.

title: O Mandarim
description: The history of Brazilian popular music in the 20th Century, focusing specially on the life and works of intriguing singer Mário Reis, a loner who, with his special way of singing - whispering and softly saying the words - in a time when singers with potent voices ruled, was in a way a forerunner of Bossa Nova style.

title: Annie O
description: When a 15-year-old female basketball prodigy makes the boys' varsity team, she inspires a media circus, sibling rivalry and a trip to the state championships in this family sports drama. Joely Collins, Chad Willet and Rob Stewart costar in this story of hoop dreams and gender lines.

description: When the cousins of a lively man throw a party as a pretence to invite the nieces of a strict captain, he poses as the boys' rich aunt, to help them get married. But, what happens if the girls' guardian takes a fancy to the hunk in drag?

title: O Outro
description: The plot revolves around two men with great physical similarity: the wealthy businessman Paulo Della Santa and the scrapyard owner Denizard de Mattos.

title: O Pão Que o Diabo Amassou
description: A ruthless loan shark doesn't realize the evil that he has done to his own family: his son is waist-deep in resentment, and his daughter- married to an unsuccessful lawyer - ends up prostituting herself.

title: O apostatis
description: An old man meets with a young hippie and they agree that the latter one will go to the old man's home. When he does, he starts having intimate relations with his wife his sister and their maid at the same time.

title: O angelos mou o diavolos mou
O bakalogatos
description: Agathonas tries to avoid marriage with Panoraia, his boss's sister.

title: O Canada
description: Created in 1939, the National Film Board of Canada has produced and distributed literally thousands of films by and about Canadians, including hundreds of animated shorts. But despite the fact that these innovative cartoons received several Oscar wins and nominations, most were little-seen by Canada's neighbors to the south.

title: O Coco, A Roda, O Pnêu e O Farol
description: A documentary about the "roda de coco" in Amaro Branco, place where, for more than 100 years, the people maintain the tradition of this contagious rhythm of the Brazilian northeast. The film shows the characters, the tradition and the wealth of this northeastern dance. More than that, it invites you to the middle of the "roda de coco".

description: A good-hearted man, betrayed by his wife and friends, fakes his death and takes up a new identity, as a nameless, wandering drunkard.

title: O Paciente
description: O Paciente

title: O Cantor e o Milionário
description: A bohemian and a businessman change bodies, causing confusion with their friends and families.

title: O hazobabas
description: More than anything in the world, a hard-working and doting father wants to see his boy become a prominent scientist and a well-respected member of the society, regardless of the cost. However, do the father and son share the same dreams?

title: O paragyios mou, o rallistas
description: Manolis, who works in the coffee house of Agisilaos, complains to his mother that he gets very tired at work, but she gets into trouble when she realizes that her son's boss is flirting with her.

title: Daddy O, Baby O!
description: Middle-aged bachelor Mario spent his life taking care of his eccentric sister Brenda. He sells goodies in a mobile cart for a living. His daily routine gets a turnaround when his dying friend Arnold makes him promise to take care of his daughter Anna. But Anna is not an ordinary little girl. Despite her angelic look, she's mischievous and in search of her estranged mother.

title: Thomas P.
description: A supernatural story about Thomas that can hear other peoples thoughts.

title: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
description: The inspirational journey of the Legend, Missile Man and 11th People's President of India.

title: T-P Bon [English] S1-S2
description: An ordinary high school student named Bon becomes part of a team of time-traveling agents tasked with saving people's lives during historical events that happen across different eras and locations around the globe.

title: DPWH?! Jhong, ginatungan ang pamumuksa ni Ion kay Vice
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Paglipay
description: The film focuses on Atan, an Aeta from Baytan village in Zambales, the Philippines, who makes a living from traditional farming system kaingin and hunting on the foothills of Mt. Pinatubo. The narrative opens as we follow Atan's fulfillment of his arranged marriage with a fellow Aeta, Ani. He has to accomplish a number of responsibilities which includes the offering of bandi or bride price to Ani's parents. Atan needs to cross the mountain river going to Banwa, the town where he could earn the necessary amount for the bride price. In order to find a job, he needs to adapt himself with the modern way of life in town, including change in appearance, manner of clothing, religious practice, and even the use of different language in order to associate himself with the Unat or 'straight-haired ones,' such as Rain, a young lass from Manila who would turn his life around. Meanwhile, Rain has to immerse with the Aetas of Banwa for her thesis, and Atan is commissioned to accompany her in research and interviews with the locals. Atan develops special feelings with Rain in his daily encounters with her. Slowly, the young Aeta forgets the very reason of his journey-the bandi, and the arrangement with Ani. In his effort to accommodate himself in a modern society, Atan faces cross-cultural modifications amid changes in the mountain brought about by immense modernity. Note: Paglipay is a Sambal Ayta term being used by Aetas when crossing the mountain river going to town.

title: Miss Q&A Belle Tinkerbell
description:
Ang goal natin sa araw na 'to, maging masaya much. Kalimutan muna ang pighati at ang mga labi ay pintahan ng ngiti. Kalmahan muna ang mga puso, parang mga boses ng Sessionistas—Nyoy Volante, Kean Cipriano, Princss Velasco, at Sitti.

Laugh trip to the highest level kasi ang hatid nina Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Barbie Nhicole Gondra, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Kantahan sa malamig na FUNanghalian ang trip nila for today's video. Si Miss Pau, songwriting ang forte. Pagbirit naman ang talent ni Barbie. Pero lahat ng 'songerists' ay walang sinabi sa lakas ng loob ni Belle, na may balak pang mag-audition sa "Tawag Ng Tanghalan." Kaya, sample naman d'yan! Mukhang bagay nga kay Belle ang mag-TNT, dahil napansin ni Meme na kamukha nito si Sofronio Vasquez. Kaya naman si Belle, binansagan niyang Sofronia Vasquech.

Dahil benta kay Meme ang mga hirit nito, binigyan niya si Belle ng sariling entablado at pagkakataon na sagutin ang mga tanong na nabunot nina Miss Pau at Barbie sa Wit Lang round.

Kinontra ni Belle ang sagot ng dalawang kandidata. Dahil napatunayan ni Belle ang kakayahan sa tanungan, mukhang malaki ang pag-asa na makabalik siya sa Resbakan. Samantala, sa araw na 'to, kay Miss Pau ang korona bilang Reyna Talaka-Era.

Mula sa lugar na pinagmulan kasarinlan ng bayan, sumugod ang mga taga-Kawit, Cavite sa Laro Laro Pick game arena para subukan ang kanilang swerte.

Pagkatapos ng masasayang laro, ang naka-survive at umabante sa jackpot round ay ang proud housewife na si Yayie, na ilalaan ang mapapanalunan para suportahan ang pag-aaral at pangarap ng mga anak.

Para palakasin ang loob ni Yayie, binalikan ng 'Gen Z' hosts ang kanilang mga childhood dreams. Alam n'yo ba? Childhood dream ni Jackie Gonzaga na maging madre.

Back to the game, nakumbinsi ni Cianne Dominguez si Yayie na piliin ang Li-POT! Naku! Lagot! Alam pala ni Yayie ang tamang sagot!

title: Miss Q&A, naging 'PISIKALAN'?
description:
Over the moon ang saya sa pagbisita ni “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” pride Carmelle Collado, fresh from her recent Eurovision Asia journey. Napili ang kantang in-interpret ni Carmelle, "Sobra-Sobra," bilang entry ng Pilipinas sa unang Eurovision Song Contest Asia.

At siyempre, kumpleto ang September 1 dahil hindi lang basta sumilip kundi live na live ang Chan-ta ng Pinas, Jose Mari Chan. Nagkatotoo ang 'memes' nang personal niyang dalhin ang Christmas feels sa “It’s Showtime.”

Wish upon a star, mga kandidata, wit at confidence nila ay on full display. Sina Ringo Antonio, Gina Ganda, at Franco Gray ang nagpakitang-gilas sa “It’s Showtime” today.

Ang trip nila, sumabak sa sayawan. May bonus performance pa si Franco, na inilabas ang kanyang action-star moves a la Coco. Pero kung hataw na hataw sila sa dance floor, medyo napaisip naman ang ating queens pagdating sa tanungan sa “Tumpak Ganern.”

Ang Wit Lang, naging exciting dahil sa face-off nina Franco at Ringo. Napunta kay Franco ang tanong na, “Bakit pa tinatawag na rush hour kung hindi naman umaandar ang traffic?” Samantala, napaisip si Ringo kung maninigarilyo pa ba ang kapre kahit may hika ito.

Habang binibilang ang mga araw bago dumating ang Christmas bonus, sa "It's Showtime" muna makilaro. Malay mo, may naghihintay na aguinaldo. Swerte kaya ay dumating nang big para sa mga taga-Lower Bicutan, Taguig.

Kilig ang regalo nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto. Si Darren, hindi makatingin nang diretso sa ka-eksena, kaya tumawag ng 'take two' si Vice Ganda. Hirit naman ni Kim Chiu, baka hindi makatingin kasi may "feelings" na?!

Ginalingan ni massage therapist Roy sa mga challenges kaya siya ang nakakuha ng spot sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P100,000 ang naghihintay. Para sa anak na nasa autism spectrum, pinili niyang lakasan ang loob at sunggaban ang pagkakataon.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Napa-KEMBOT at napa-OOOH LA LA na ang buong bayan kaya may bagong assignment sa sayawan. Ihanda ang bewang at ang energy para sa todong galawan dahil sa bagong dance craze na sinimulan ng Showtime Baby Dolls. Bagong kanta nila titled "Meme" ang bagong sasabayan sa sayawan!

Kapag wit at talakan ang subject, mga accla ay valedictorian. Kaya deserve koronahan. Sina Jemzian Seco, Kea Marie Kipling, at Josh De Leon ang sumabak sa Miss Q and A examination kung saan kailangan nilang mapahanga ang buong nation sa pagsagot sa mga playtime questions.

Kahit napagod sa biyahe na tumagal dahil sa baha, laban pa rin si Jemzian. Si Kea naman ay isang optometrist na Rank 7 sa board exam. At pinatunayan nga niya ang pagiging brainy nang mapa-wow niya si Vice Ganda dahil hindi pa man tapos basahin ang tanong ay agad siyang nakasagot—complete with a full explanation!

Sina Kea at Jemzian ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At para bang meant to be ang nabunot na tanong ni Kea, “Kung isa kang optometrist, anong ia-advise mo sa pasyente kapag sinabi niyang malabo ang kanyang third eye?”

Pero mas meant to be ang korona kay Jemzian, na tumatak sa mga hurado at Madang People dahil sa nagkandaligaw-ligaw niyang sagot sa tanong na, “Anong mas masakit? Bigyan ka ng mag-asawang sampal o sampalin ka ng mag-asawa?”

Mapa-araw o gabi, sila ang tagabantay ng safety. Sila ang mga hardworking security guards mula Pasig City.

Inspirasyon ni Koriks ang limang anak. Kaya para sa kanilang pag-aaral, willing siyang sumugal para sa ₱200,000 POT money. Kinumbinsi naman siya nina Brent Manalo, Ralph de Leon, at ng Baby Dolls na kunin ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer sa pamamagitan ng dance number.

Pero sa huli, pinakinggan ni Koriks ang gusto ng anak na subukan ang POT question. Dahil gusto ni Meme Vice na masayang umuwi si Koriks, binigyan niya ito ng sampung libo.

title: Miss Q&A Jeraldine & Franco
description:
Inabangan ng sangkabaklaan ang harapan ng mga beki na mahusay sa talakan. Mula Lunes hanggang Biyernes sa “It’s Showtime,” sinala ang mga kandidata sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan, at sa araw na 'to, Sabado, nagkaalaman na kung sino sa limang weekly finalists ang best.

Chukchak mode on sina Ivern Doroteo, Ringo Antonio, Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, Franco Gray, at Billy Labitan Yadao. Bago ang talak, sunod-sunod agad ang patutsada ng mga baklang 'di pakakabog sa isa't isa. At sino itong kandidata na tila ba napagtulungan ng mga kasamahan?

Mula lima, apat ang pumaslak sa Wit Lang round. Mga tanong dito, hindi naman kailangan dibdibin, mas okay kung sasakyan ang 'amats' at lalaruin. At ang Top 2 wittiest candidates of them all, sina Billy at Ringo, umabante sa next round na Beklamation.

Umugong ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena! Umugong din ang pag-asa para sa players na mula sa Brgy. Ugong, Pasig City. Sino kaya ang makakatawid hanggang jackpot round, at makakapag-uwi ng POT money na P300,000?

Fresh frm breakup pa si Sharmy nang maki-join sa kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick. Naikuwento rin niya kung bakit sila naghiwalay ni ex. At ang dahilan? Girl best friend! Kaya sina Anne Curtis at ibang hosts ay napaisip, red flag ba ang isang taong committed na pero super close at minsan nag-a-"I love you" kay best?

Umabante sa jackpot round ang mapagmahal na asawa at ama na si Kokey. Eh di isama na 'yan sa Team Loyal a.k.a. ang samahan ng mga takot sa asawa!

title: Marina Summers bilang hurado sa Miss Q and A
description:
Sabi nila, may darating na someone, someday, 'yung kapag nakita mo siya parang laging may background music ang paligid. Kapit lang, dahil minsan dumarating 'yan nang biglaan. Habang hinihintay ang pagdating ng pag-ibig, heto na si Mr. Randomantic James Reid, handang magpakilig!

Lahat sa mundo may halaga, mula sa mga kulisap hanggang bulaklak sa hardin at mga puno (please huwag naman natin silang putulin). Sa Miss Q and A, boses ng mga kandidata ay may halaga at aral na puwedeng pulutin.

Huwag 'inaancha' ang mga kandidata dahil hindi sila basta-basta. May maipagmamalaking talento, talino at puso sina Summer Rejane Corpuz, Wilson The Buss, at Jomaima Johnson na nagpagalingan sa talakan.

Hot na hot talaga ang puksaan with special guest hurado Marina Summers. Present pa rin si Nicole Cordoves, with Ralph de Leon. Sina Wilson The Buss at Jomaima ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Parehobg bumoses, pero sa korona, isa lang ang sumakses! Si Jomaima ang wagi bilang Miss Q&A Reyna Talakers of the day.

Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Tonsuya, Malabon sa game arena.

Pagdating ng You Gotta Lyric round, si Dalag ang only player na naka-survive! Baka pampaalis ng kaba, nakipa-playtime si Dalag sa mga trip ni Vice Ganda hanggang sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000 ay kanyang tinanggap.

title: MC at Lassy hindi nagpakabog sa Miss Q&A stage
description:
Hindi suspended ang good vibes dito sa "It's Showtime" dahil tuloy-tuloy lang ang buhos ng tawanan at happiness. Parang Signal No. 4 ang intensity ng biritan sa FUNanghalian handog nina "TNT Duets" 2 champs Christian Tibayan at Arvery Lagoring.

Pati ang "Ohhh Lala Baby," naging mapanakit! Pero kung duet lang naman ang usapan, lalaban ang pares nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto aka DaCkie d'yan! Eh, magpapakabog ba naman ang BreCkie?! Si Brent Manalo, nag-warm up pa, sabay 'da move' na siguradong kikiligin ka Dong digi digi dong! Aha!

Heto, may bago! Ralph de Leon at Lassy aka RalphSy! Hirit ni Lassy, kung siya ang pinili ni Ralph papunta sa kanyang puso, siguradong may papaldo!

Sa "Miss Q and A," kapag hindi alam ang sagot, you've got to shoot your shot, bes! Sabay ngiti at sabi ng, "And, I thank you!" Malakas ang arrive nina candidates JV Zeped, Audrey Zunega, at Carla Shuvee Medalla, na sa bawat hampas ng balakang sa pagrampa, ika'y mapapa-ohhh lala.

Sa "Wit Lang" kung saan sina Carla at Audrey ang nagharapan, nabunot ni Carla ang tanong na, "Payag ka kung passenger princess ka pero nakasabit ka?" Ang tanong naman kay Audrey, "Payag ka masarap ka magmahal pero wala kang panlasa?"

Mag-manicure ay 'di biro, maghapong nakayuko sa pagkuskos ng kuko. Kaya deserve ng mga madlang manikurista players ang isang masayang bonding at laro sa game arena.

It's giving girl power si nanay Lisa sa Laro Laro Pick. Ikinuwento niya ang hirap at sarap ng pagiging isang solo parent ngayong graduate na ang mga anak sa kolehiyo. Paldo naman sa kilig si Jelai dahil kay Vhong Navarro. At sa sobrang kilig, naligaw pa ang 'I love you' na para kay mister!

Ang naglaro sa jackpot, si Bhels, na 35 years nang itinataguyod ang pamilya sa pamamagitan ng mani-pedi. Kaya naman super deserve ni nanay ang P25,000 Li-Pot offer, na malaking ginhawa na para sa kan'yang pamilya.

title: Amats malala! EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nagpakilala sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: Meme Vice, unli ang energy! USAPANG CRUSH sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

title: You're Hired!
description:
After the "mysterious" death of a colleague, the doldrums of office life at DanRick Designs are given a surprise resuscitation when Miles Fuller and Dylan Kirkpatrick discover they are the lead candidates for a promotion. The timing of the advancement opportunity couldn't be more ideal for the entry-level employees. The Tech Center where Miles' voluntarily teaches inner city teens is low on funds, and Dylan is desperate to purchase the home his deceased father built by hand, before his mother is manipulated by his weasel stepdad to put it on the market. The pay increase from the promotion could resolve their dilemmas, except only one of them can win the job.

Peers and family deceive the young men into believing racial disparities always impact office politics, so assertive, yet questionable actions, may be necessary to level the playing field if they really want the job. Is ethical compromise justified for a moral cause? Miles and Dylan will journey down a rabbit hole that not only answers the question, but drops them in the middle of chaos and high jinks so wild, staying alive becomes more vital than the job!

With a colorful cast (literally) of quirky characters, You're Hired, explores both internal and external perceptions and struggles of race and identity. This social satire avoids political correctness, opting to poke fun at the ignorance and insecurities that create unnecessary division. Sometimes laughing at stereotypes is simply wiser than allowing them validity, especially in today's America.

title: Ek Mahanayak - Dr B R Ambedkar
description: Ek Mahanayak is the story of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar, the founding father of the Constitution of India. For the first time, the story of Babasaheb will be shown on television through serial. The show will include inspiring parts of Babasaheb's life. The story of this show will begin from the childhood of Babasaheb. In which Bhimrao Ambedkar's role will be seen playing child artist Aayudh Bhanushali. Later Prasad Jawade will be seen in the role of young Baba Saheb.

title: The R-Truth Game Show

description: Alberto needs to save his family's print shop. His plans are complicated when he falls in love with single mother Sofía, the daughter of a shady business magnate who could make or break Alberto's future.

title: S. O. S. Iceberg
description: An expedition goes in search of a party lost the year before.

title: S nulya
description: The action will unfold in two time periods at once: in our time and in 2008. The storylines will develop in parallel until they merge into an integral chronology of the lives of two friends who studied at the same university and lived in the same room, but in the end went completely different paths.

title: Morena(s)
description: A Dominican immigrant in Buenos Aires struggles to maintain afloat her business and the dream of bringing her teenage son to Argentina.

title: Werewolf Women of the S.S.
description: Rob Zombie's fake trailer for "Grindhouse" is a sendup of 1970s Nazisploitation films.

title: Musique(s) électronique(s)
description: A documentary about musique concrète and electronic music, from Luigi Russolo's manifesto "The art of noises" (1913) to the new generation. We discover a large history of electro-acoustic music. Some composers as François Bayle, Michel Chion, Christian Zanési, Emilie Simon, Kasper T. Toeplitz, Teho Teardo talk about how (and why) they create experimental pieces. It's a discovery of a new gender of music often considered as too elitist.

title: Devushka s kosoy
description: The residents of a Moscow condominium would face lots of funny yet thrilling events right before the New Year. A girl with scythe is coming. Would she find her way, or would everyone celebrate the holiday safe and healthy?..

title: Pure S
description: A group of Australian heroin addicts go out and try to score a hit after a friend overdoses.

title: S=13
description: An abstract short film by Nobuhiro Aihara that combines the movement of abstract lines and the motif of an apple.

title: Kukla s millionami
description: The rich widow Madame Collie leaves the fortune to her lost niece Maria Ivanova. Two cousins of Maria go from Paris to Moscow in order to search her.

title: Paren s Marsa
description: Black comedy about the routine of a large corporation, producing chocolate bars. The claustrophobic office space and its dwellers are part of a funny and grotesque picture. The main character, young man from the marketing department, tries to find his stolen car with the help of militia and head of a local gang. He confronts a chaotic life of a small provincial town outside his office, trying to guess its laws. As a result, he fails to fulfill the task of his American boss, and finds his Ford painted and rebuilt as a street-racer's car. Of course, his personal life also changes...

title: Malchanie s dostoynstvo
description: Silence with Dignity is a documentary about the life and work of the famous Bulgarian film directors, the family of Irina Aktasheva and Hristo Piskov. It is a story about their emblematic films and of those whose realization was banned, the criteria according to which a film was classified as "too dangerous" under communism, the mechanisms of censorship, their persistence and creative survival and their silence charged with dignity. The film reveals unknown details of the history of Bulgarian cinema and the link between the political elite and the intellectuals at the time.

title: Parkour(s)
description: One morning, everyone heads to the wedding hall for various reasons, including the street vendor, kitchen worker, singer, and others. They all have different motivations to attend Khaled and Kamilah's wedding.

title: B.F.'s Daughter
description: Wealthy Polly Fulton marries a progressive scholar whose attitudes toward capitalism and acquired wealth puts their marriage in jeopardy.

title: Violent Sh*t
description: A demented, wicked, deformed, cannibalistic killer named K. The Butcher Shitter, escapes from the police and slaughters people in many gory, bloody ways.

title: Morgen gaat 't beter!
description: Willy Verhulst's life isn't easy. She's struggling at school, her father suddenly dies and she can't find a job. She doesn't lose her optimism though.

title: T-Bag Strikes Again
description: T. Bag has regained her powers and calls her former servant, Thomas, into a storybook and makes him serve her tea again as 'T.Shirt'. Debbie follows her friend and soon discovers she has to locate all the silver numbers from the town clock that T.Bag has hidden in the book's various chapters.

title: Big-T Explores the Galaxy
description: Join Big T the super-smart T-Rex as he goes on quest for knowledge in this educational film for all ages. Ride along on the journey of a lifetime as Big-T Explores The Galaxy.

title: Don't Hesitate
description: A brokenhearted woman makes a romantic connection with a man who doesn't believe in love. For this relationship to work, both must learn to trust one another by overcoming their respective fear of being hurt again.

title: Young Fast & Fierce
description: A group of children create an illegal car race, while trying to hide from the police.

title: W
description: Katie Lewis and her husband Ben discover that they are the targets of a mysterious killer who leaves the letter W at the scene of their near-fatal "accidents." While trying to avoid death, the couple must struggle to discover the source of these attacks.

title: W
description:
W - If Woman is one of the words which comes to your mind, this movie is for you!

Open-minded, ambitious Sandhya Singh a.k.a Sandy (Leeza Mangaldas); Traditional, romantic Roohi Malik (Lezlie Tripathy) and Rebellious, lesbian (gay) Manu (Sonal Giani) are musicians & best friends forever (BFF) who run an event management company called W.

Short of funds and racing against time on their journey to organize their biggest music event yet The Freedom Concert they unexpectedly encounter The introvert, fanatic Abhay a.k,a. Bhaiji (Raaj Singh Arora); Mentally unstable Dhruv (Danish Pandor) & Womanizer Chotu (Abhay Attri). Although of good social standing, these men have issues with urbanization & modernity!

Not a battle of fists, W comes as a contemporary youthful musical thriller which explores the clash between the Women of Today and Men of Yesterday and how each side justifies their actions, words and mindset while setting an example for the rest of us without being preachy.

title: Generation W
description: Génération W, c'est une compétition où les équipes, flanquées de leurs supporters et de leur 'coach', peuvent se mesurer entre elles. On met chaque équipe au défi: on teste leur habilité à manier la manette, leur enthousiasme, leur débrouillardise et leurs connaissances. Mais c'est aussi des trucs pour mieux manoeuvrer dans l'univers des jeux, des cédéroms et de l'Internet; de nouvelles capsules anecdotiques où on découvre la petite histoire des jeux et des nouvelles technologies, une rubrique où on partage nos coups de coeur en matière de produits multimédia - mais où on se permet aussi de donner des coups de pied et de renvoyer les concepteurs à leur table à dessin; des reportages où on découvre des créateurs et des technologies à la sauce GW et un quizz où on jour le tout pour le tout pour mieux s'assurer la victoire.

title: W'z S1-S2

title: W spirali
description: An out of town car trip, which was meant to have a purifying effect on the trouble-stricken married couple, turns into a dangerous interaction between characters when they pick up an eccentric traveler, Tamir. Tamir is a witness to, and a catalyst of their problems, a self-appointed healer wishing to become their path to enlightenment. Krzysztof and Agnes know they shouldn't be together but they are unable to part, or perhaps they do not want to? "Into the Spiral" is a story of love which is restless, dangerous and toxic.

title: Ana w Hiyya W Haya
description: Ana w Hiyya W Haya

title: Czekam w Monte-Carlo
description: At the annual car race in Monte Carlo the Polish team consists of driver Piotr and his pilot Jan. They compete with other teams as well as with one another - for the feelings of one woman.

title: Qesma w Naseeb
description: A reality TV show hosted by the star Rita Harb that gathers young men and women from different Arab countries on a secluded island in Turkey with the goal of finding true love.

title: Dancing in the Corner
description: After the fall of communism in 1989, color TVs were no longer a luxury good in Poland. The screens in many Polish homes are beginning to look more like the reality outside the window. But is reality truly colorful?

title: Taxi Driver S1-S3
description: The story of a deluxe taxi driver who gets revenge on behalf of his passengers. It is based on the webtoon Deluxe Taxi by Carlos and Lee Jae-jin

title: W bialy dzien
description: Set in 1905. The story focuses on a young and inexperienced man in a revolutionary execution squad. He does his killing job out of idealism, and for the love of a woman. The young student murders a Russian spy and is afterwards arrested by the police. Much to his surprise he is released after a session with the traitor-judge, hinting at some leaks in the organization. Student reports his suspicions back to the organization, but in response is given a new hit mission, aimed at a Polish writer believed to be collaborating with the Russians. The killer comes to Cracow where the writer lives and comes to a conclusion that perhaps the writer is innocent, since there is no conclusive evidence.

title: Bitch X Rich [Hindi]
description: It portrays what happens after the dirty Kim Hye-in, the only witness to the murder of a high school girl, moves to Cheongdam International High School, where everyone wants, and meets Baek Je, the main suspect.

title: X Ray Visions
description: A casual, in-depth account of the life and times of one of the most important cultural epicenters in Portland's history, X-Ray Visions tells the story of the X-Ray Cafe, R.I.P. 1994. Did you ever wonder how Portland appeared on the map as THE epicenter for weird, alternative arts and culture - it was because of the X-Ray - a wholly singular all-ages venue with a true anything goes aesthetic--a punk band, a circus act, toddlers banging on things, and a man spanking volunteers might all appear on a single bill--and its presence in Old Town in the early 90's put Portland on the map as a radical, rock and roll kind of town. Awesome for the nostalgic and the curious alike.

title: Mr. X, a Vision of Leos Carax
description: The image of a mysterious, solitary filmmaker - a cineaste maudit - who flees from both the media and the public, is unrelentingly bound to the figure of Leos Carax, in France. Elsewhere, the real focus is on his films and he is considered to be an icon of world cinema. Mr.X dives into the poetic and visionary world of an artist who was already a cult figure from his very first film. Punctuated by interviews and unseen footage, this documentary is most of all a fine-tuned exploration of the poetic and visionary world of Leos Carax, alias "Mr.X".

title: Al A'ela X
description: The events follow a forty-year-old widow whose teenage son disappears, so she begins a journey to search for him and discover his secrets and his private world

title: Courier X
description: A smuggler of black market merchandise is solicited by the CIA for deleterious involvement with Flight TWA 800 and to cover up a Nicaraguan blackmail attempt on the agency.

title: Soledad y Larguirucho
description: Soledad Pastorutti and his friend Larguirucho go on a tour through Argentina while evading the wrong deeds of Cachavacha, the witch.

title: Moros y cristianos
description: A peculiar family who owns a nougat factory decides to set out on a trip to Madrid to advertise their products in a Food Fair. Besides the disapproval from the family head and company founder, events are not as expected.

title: Dama y obrero
description: Julio Ulloa is a boy who has had very little luck in his life so far. He has done everything, like working on anything or the first thing he finds. For her part, Ignacia Villavicencio is an engineer who currently works at Constructora Omega and is about to marry Tomás Ahumada, an architect by profession who was her professor at university and is currently the owner of Constructora Omega.

title: Valeria y Maximiliano
description: Romance, corruption, intrigue, sadness, envy, story full of energy. Most importantly courage.

title: Amigas y rivales
description: Jimena De la O, the daughter of the richest man in Mexico is a troubled teen along with her best friend Ofelia, the two despise others who are not at their socioeconomical level, and live a fast, wild life, but then comes Laura, a middle class girl that teaches them that money, and status isn't everything, then there's Nayeli, the cook at the De la O's residence that longs for Jimena's acceptance as a person, and into her group with big dreams of becoming a Hollywood star.

title: Cuerpo y alma
description: Tried and true story of three young buddies thrust into danger (in this case, World War I aviation), some of whom come back, while some are less lucky. Films about WWI fliers had been spectacularly successful in the U.S. in the early 1930s, like "Wings," "Hell's Angels," and "Dawn Patrol." The Fox Studio evidently hoped this particular story, written by Furthman and others, had enough box office potential that Fox filmed it in 2 versions, the original English-speaking one (see under "Body and Soul" (1931)), and this Spanish-language "Cuerpo y alma" [literal translation of "Body and Soul"]. In the Spanish version the three fliers were played by Lewis (Farrell's role), Alcantara (Bogart), Nieto (Dillaway) and the two women by Custodio (Landi) and Soler (Loy). It's ironic that this Spanish version actually ran a half-hour longer than the original English one (99 min. vs. 70 min.), although it's the same story filmed in the same sets. Perhaps Fox was so disappointed with the English-speaking result that after completion the studio cut it down radically (to play on US screens as part of a double feature), while the Spanish version actually preserved intact the complete original story...? (Something similar did happen that same year to the English and Spanish versions of "Dracula.")

title: Platero y yo
description: After a long period of absence, living in large and anonymous cities, a poet, Juan, returns to the village of his birth, Moguer, there he finds happiness through; the friendship of a small donkey, Platero, a free spirited girl, Aguedilla, and recalling memories of his childhood.

title: Cilantro y perejil
description: This is a comedy about couples from the same family, hit by the economic crisis in Mexico. The plot turns around the eternal question of whether it is worth it to live as a couple.

title: Esquivar y pegar
description: Benito Eufemia has spent 9 years in prison. Now he's waiting for his last boxing match.

title: García y García
description: Two men with the same name endure the funny consequences of getting mixed up during a business trip.

title: Pan y Circo
description: Conversations unite experts and different personalities to touch fundamental topics of universal interest in contemporary societies, accompanied by the menus of well-known Mexican chefs.

title: 40 y tantos
description: Comedy focusing on the mid-life crises of three siblings.

title: Romeo y Julieta
description: Two teenagers fall in love, but their feuding families and fate itself cause the relationship to end in tragedy.

title: Y-Destiny
description: Y-Destiny is the story of 7 best friends: Sun, Mon, Tue, Puth, Thurs, Masuk and Sat, each of whom has different personalities according to their birthdays and fate leads them to meet their loved ones.

description: For Enrique and Judita dancing tango means living their dream. They were tango Vice World Champions in Buenos Aires in 2003. This movie is dedicated to their fight for honesty in art and love.

title: Naranja y media
description: Juan Guerrero has problems with his partner so they distance themselves, at that time he meets Ángeles 'Lali' Zabala and falls in love with her. title: The Z
description: Mars Heflin and his Protection Incorporated security team are the only force standing in the way of the ancient, ravenous species known as The Z as they seek to destroy the city.

title: Prep Z
description: A reluctant zombie prepper must take charge and fight off a self proclaimed survivalist to reunite his team of misfits who may or may not have lost patient zero.

title: Z Gaming Guy
description: Welcome to my channel everyone. Here I will be doing gameplays in all types of genre's, among other things.

title: Moja Generacija Z
description: The "My Generation Z" series talks about teenagers who succeeded the famous "millennials" , the "Z" generation, or the graduates of Belgrade high school(born in 2000, in the year of the dragon in Chinese astrology). We follow the two-class heroes (from blue and red shift) in the first day of new school year in which they will make the important life desicions.Dramatic complications, enriched with humor and music, talk about dilemmas and problems, as well as the joys in the life of young people in Serbia, their parents and professors.

title: Kluci z bronzu
description: Military are performing their difficult "Spartakiad" sports composition (National gymnastics festival) at the Strahov stadium in Prague. Major Melichar and major Rybár have been proudly watching the soldiers, sharing the joy over the large applause by the audience. Only captain Chmelar is missing, who was successfully preparing the division unit for their performance. It was not an easy job. The composition was demanding, and major Melichar insisted that the soldiers must not neglect any of their regular military duties.

title: Mazinger Z [English]
description: Teenager Koji Kabuto pilots the amazing super-robot Mazinger Z to avenge its inventor (his grandfather) against the Mycene Empire, led by the evil mad scientist Doctor Hell.

title: Pozegnanie z Maria
description: Jewish girl escapes from Ghetto and enters the world of Poles revealing various life attitudes... The dramatic story of human fate, feelings, and passions, which takes place during a period of contempt for all normal values. Love, hate, fear and death, and by their side people's normal existence, filled with compromises, illegal business dealings during the war years. The picture that not only shows in full the system by which people are destroyed, but its results for the human psyche and moral values. It fully exptains how the mechanisms of change are introduced into people, the personal philosophy adopted in order to survive, the neighboring borders between good and evil.

title: At Ground Zero
description: Tom and Aysha are at the economic bottom of the LA scene; no money, on drugs, and selling themselves to exist. Tom brains his drug dealer, steals his drugs and the two split town by bus and thumb, heading 'home'. Hitching a ride from a quixotic, dangerous character, Bubba, they put up with his advances until he too is ejected from his own car as the two free themselves from all restraint. Aysha starts a real spiral into heroin, as Tom joins in, but spirits are high. They run into a hilarious character, Carman, who they enlist in their fun, as the trip escalates into the threesomes' investigation of freedom, drugs, and abandonment. Carman leaves the duo, and Aysha falls into a drug appetite Tom can't understand and in frustration he hurts her. Together, but separate, they endure the car ride as they head for Minneapolis and home. In the end, the couples explore the detritus of their family, and lives, and even in betrayal have passion for each other. On a final, bittersweet note, Carman continues his self-destructive ways, as some hope endures.

title: Absolute Zero
description: Suansoon and Ongsa are in a relationship, but an accident occurred when Ongsa rushed to celebrate Suansoon's birthday and also their anniversary. Wracked with guilt, Suansoon wishes to go back in time to prevent their relationship.
